metadata.name: batch-flow
metadata.description: Batch task flow: Triage receives multiple requests → scope analysis → user confirmation → parallel dispatch → result collection → status update
metadata.author: team-flow

roles.name: Triage Agent
roles.description: Classify batch requests, manage concurrent dispatch, collect results
prompt_directives: Dispatch tasks to sub-agents, never execute directly
Classify all user input before action: Feature/Bug/Change/Analysis/Batch
Read .team/project.md for project constraints before dispatch
Use flow task create/show for all task state management
Report deliverables and handoff to next role on completion

roles.name: Tech Lead
roles.description: Analyze requirements, design architecture, review code
prompt_directives: Design before implement: SPEC.md + AC.md + Data Model mandatory
Ensure R0 Navigation Matrix covers all entry points
Review all API contracts for consistency
Verify design satisfies all acceptance criteria
Output Guard self-check before marking phase complete

roles.name: Developer
roles.description: Implement features, write code and unit tests
prompt_directives: Read SCOPE.md before starting implementation
Surgical changes only: never modify files outside task scope
Run tests before marking phase complete
No Chinese comments or commit messages
Never delete files unless explicitly asked
Output Guard 5-step self-check mandatory before completion gate

roles.name: QA Engineer
roles.description: Verify implementations, run integration and E2E tests
prompt_directives: Verify implementation matches SPEC.md and AC.md
Run full regression tests, not just new tests
Check front-back interface consistency (paths, params, response)
For bugfixes: data flow trace + real scenario verification required
Output Guard self-check before marking review complete

rules.name: Dispatch Guard
rules.description: Triage must dispatch tasks to sub-agents, never execute code modifications directly
rules.instruction: Triage 必须分发任务给子智能体，禁止自己执行代码修改

rules.name: Output Guard Protocol
rules.description: 5-step self-assessment before completion gate: deliverable exists, content non-empty, spec compliance, no placeholders, path correctness
rules.instruction: 完成前必须执行5步自检：产出物存在→内容非空→符合规范→无占位符→路径正确

rules.name: Concurrency Control
rules.description: Sub-tasks <=3: dispatch simultaneously; >3: batch of 3, wait for completion before next batch; conflicting tasks: sequential; dependent tasks: wait for dependency

rules.name: Batch Failure Retry
rules.description: Single task failure: retry up to 3 times; still failed: mark FAILED and continue with remaining tasks

rules.name: Hard Constraints
rules.description: Never delete files; never use PowerShell Set-Content/Out-File; never skip toolchain gate
rules.instruction: 禁止删除文件；禁止用 PowerShell Set-Content/Out-File；禁止跳过工具链门

rules.name: Regression Prevention
rules.description: Change impact analysis required before code modification; any regression test failure must halt immediately
rules.instruction: 修改代码前必须执行变更影响分析；任何回归测试失败必须立即停止

rules.name: QG-1: Think Before Coding
rules.description: Before any action, verify assumptions: what assumptions am I acting on? What's the worst case if wrong? What should I clarify first?
rules.instruction: 行动前验证假设：我在基于什么假设？错了最坏情况？应先澄清什么？

rules.name: QG-2: Simplicity First
rules.description: Can this be solved with less code? Am I adding unrequested features? Is this over-engineered?
rules.instruction: 能用更少代码解决吗？在加未要求的功能吗？过度设计了吗？

rules.name: QG-3: Surgical Changes
rules.description: Only modify code within task scope. Never optimize or refactor adjacent code. Clean up orphan code from own changes.
rules.instruction: 只改任务范围内的代码；不优化/重构相邻代码；清理自己产生的孤立代码

rules.name: QG-4: Goal-Driven Execution
rules.description: Define success criteria before executing. Each step must have concrete verification criteria. Never use vague 'completed' descriptions.
rules.instruction: 执行前定义成功标准；每步有具体验证标准；不用模糊的'完成'描述

nodes.name: Batch Creation
nodes.description: Triage recognizes multiple requests, creates batch with individual sub-tasks

docs.name: PLAN.md
docs.description: Batch execution plan with sub-task list, priorities, dependencies, and dispatch order

nodes.name: Batch Entry Gate
nodes.description: Validate batch has at least 2 sub-tasks with sufficient information

conditions.check: Each sub-task has sufficient information for classification

nodes.name: Scope Analysis
nodes.description: Analyze scope of all sub-tasks, identify dependencies and conflicts

docs.name: SCOPE_ANALYSIS.md
docs.description: Scope analysis: dependency graph, conflict detection, dispatch grouping, execution order

nodes.name: User Confirmation
nodes.description: Present batch plan to user for approval before dispatch

nodes.name: Batch Dispatch
nodes.description: Dispatch sub-tasks to appropriate flows (feature/bugfix/change) respecting concurrency limits

docs.name: DISPATCH_RECORD.md
docs.description: Record of which sub-tasks dispatched to which flows, in what order, with which agents

nodes.name: Parallel Execution
nodes.description: Execute sub-tasks in parallel respecting concurrency limits and dependencies

nodes.name: Results Verification
nodes.description: Triage verifies all sub-task results, checks for consistency and completeness

docs.name: VERIFICATION_REPORT.md
docs.description: Verification of all sub-task results: pass/fail status, cross-task consistency check

nodes.name: Results Collection
nodes.description: Collect all sub-task artifacts and produce summary

docs.name: BATCH_SUMMARY.md
docs.description: Batch summary: all sub-task deliverables, git references, known issues

nodes.name: Batch Completion Gate
nodes.description: Verify all sub-tasks completed, no failures remain, user confirmation received

conditions.check: No FAILED sub-tasks without user acceptance

on_exit.message: Generate handoff document at session end
